question.question: How can an underbutler be acquired in the base game, when is it available, and can another player recruit it?

key.expected_answer: Only acquire Butler’s Pantry; gain underbutler from supply immediately into Expended Service. Cannot hire with Butler’s Room or hire-servant VP card; unique, cannot be recruited.

a.answer: The only way to acquire an underbutler is to purchase Butler’s Pantry; take one from the supply immediately into Expended Service. The setup stocks two underbutlers total in Servants for Hire, but Butler’s Room and Hire Servant VP cards cannot hire them. Another player cannot recruit one: the upgraded Butler’s Room recruits only common servants, and unique servants cannot leave their owner’s employ.
a.evidence: ‘Butler’s Pantry: purchasing it is the only way to acquire an underbutler’; take one from supply into Expended Service. Butler’s Room/VP cards exclude them; upgraded recruitment is for common servants. Setup specifies two underbutlers total.

b.answer: The only way to acquire an underbutler is purchasing Butler’s Pantry; take one from supply immediately into Expended Service. Butler’s Room and Hire Servant VP cards cannot hire one. The summary does not specify a separate time restriction on purchasing Butler’s Pantry or availability timing beyond immediate placement in Expended Service. Another player cannot recruit it: the upgraded Butler’s Room recruits only a common servant, and unique servants cannot be recruited.
b.evidence: “Butler’s Pantry: purchasing it is the only way to acquire an underbutler; take one from the supply immediately into Expended Service.” Butler’s Room recruit option is limited to common servants; unique servants cannot be recruited.
